reasons.action: The request only combines body and wheels into one subject; it does not ask the car to perform a new action or behavior, so the observed reference action governs.
reasons.medium: The request does not authorize a rendering transformation; both references are live-action, so the reference medium is preserved.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing, accessory, or vehicle trim change is requested; the observed reference appearance governs wardrobe-level attributes.
reasons.lighting: The request contains no instruction about illumination, light source, direction, or quality, so reference lighting governs.
reasons.framing: The request specifies no camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint, or movement; aspect ratio alone does not govern framing.
reasons.palette: No color, tonal grading, saturation, or contrast treatment is requested, so the reference palette governs.
